content.text:
I fixed it in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`. Now `v-for` over a `shallowReactive` array gives you the items as they are, so the issue's example prints "object object".

**Cause:** `renderList` passed every item of any reactive array through `toReactive`. That's wrong for a shallow array, whose items shouldn't be made reactive. Making the item reactive unwrapped its ref, so `typeof item.aaa` came out as `'string'`.

**Fix:** items are only wrapped when the array isn't shallow. I also changed one more case: items from a `readonly(reactive([...]))` array now come out read-only too. Before, they came out reactive but writable.

**Testing:**
- The 7 existing `renderList` tests pass.
- I ran a temporary test (then deleted it) for three cases, and all passed:
  - the issue's shallow case gives `'object'`
  - `readonly(reactive(...))` items are read-only
  - plain `reactive` items are still reactive

I didn't add a permanent test. The only change in the repo is in `renderList.ts`.
